events.title: Hexrite Demo Out Now!
events.summary: We're proud to announce that the demo for Hexrite has now released on Steam! You can download it straight from the main store page! Explore the coral-filled Nuvemar, face a series of challenging bizarre enemies and meet the Dream Empress at the top of her ruined castle! Don't forget to join our Discord for any bug reports or feedback you might have, alternatively you can talk with us through the Steam Forums, enjoy the demo and thank you for all your support thus far!

events.title: Hexrite wins Best Game at the PlayStation Talents Awards!
events.summary: Last week during our first public showing of Hexrite at both Lisboa Games Week and MEO XL Games, Hexrite was one of the 10 finalists for the PlayStation Talents Awards, being nominated for 3 categories: Best Game Award, Press Award and Best Art Award. We're happy to announce we've won 2 of these: 🏆 Best Game Award! 🏆 Press Award!
